title: C0-C3 evaluation-condition matrix
author: Faye Niu
purpose: Define the operational and authority boundaries of C0-C3, their common comparison controls, their distinct scoring points, and the evidence state that may presently be claimed for each condition.

status.interpretation: Author synthesis of frozen project contracts. The matrix specifies planned comparison conditions and current evidence states; it is not an experimental result.

placement.purpose: Place METH-T1 on one dedicated portrait page immediately after Section 3.2 and prevent Section 3.3 from preceding it when the exhibit is input at the approved chapter location.

inputs.role: Binding evaluand, C0-C3 operational definitions, parity rule, executable-state wording and D0-D2 evidence boundary.
inputs.locator: Headings 'Protocol status', 'Research question and system under test', 'Experimental conditions', 'Research propositions', 'Dataset partitions and leakage control', 'D0: fictional development and evaluation cases', 'D1: authorised pilot set', and 'D2: final new-case set'.

inputs.role: Approved Section 3.2 scope, current C0/C3 go-no-go state and exclusion of live-unrun company research from the frozen experiment.
inputs.locator: Headings 'Implemented case study and held future evaluation' and 'Current go/no-go state - 27 August 2026'; detailed chapter-plan entries '3.2 Evaluand and conditions' and '5.7 Manual and HITL comparison'.

inputs.role: Project evidence hierarchy and prohibition on presenting synthetic, test or design evidence as a real-world finding.
inputs.locator: Opening evidence-category definitions for 'Source evidence', 'Implementation evidence', 'Protocol' and 'Finding'; statement that no synthetic observation, automated test, stakeholder assertion or design intention is represented as a real-world finding; headings 'Success definition' and 'Primary risks'.

inputs.role: Implemented-versus-protocol-only status convention, condition-relevant verifier/report controls and evidence-class separation requirement.
inputs.locator: Status convention directly before the requirements tables; requirements FR-AGT-001--FR-AGT-005, FR-VER-001--FR-VER-007, FR-REP-001--FR-REP-009, NFR-REL-002, NFR-PERF-001 and NFR-RES-001--NFR-RES-003.

row_traceability.current_go_no_go: NO-GO pending verified authority, gold construction and protocol freeze
row_traceability.scoring_boundary: Completed authorised manual report; timing and corrections only where the frozen protocol permits
row_traceability.assistance_boundary: Any established tool or model assistance must be recorded so the condition is not mislabelled as manual.

row_traceability.current_go_no_go: Executable for D0 engineering and mechanism evidence
row_traceability.scoring_boundary: Automated C1 report before any human review
row_traceability.assistance_boundary: No independent verifier and no human edits before scoring.

row_traceability.current_go_no_go: Executable for D0 engineering and mechanism evidence
row_traceability.scoring_boundary: Verifier-gated C2 report before human review
row_traceability.assistance_boundary: The independent verifier controls support eligibility and is separate from extraction and composition.

row_traceability.current_go_no_go: Human execution NO-GO pending verified authority and protocol freeze
row_traceability.scoring_boundary: Approved post-review version scored separately from its pre-review C2 version
row_traceability.assistance_boundary: The named reviewer may edit, approve or reject under the authorised protocol but does not replace the independent gold reference.

shared_parity_contract: Same canonical metric definitions for all comparable conditions.
Same reporting period for all comparable conditions.
Same eligible input and source-access window for all comparable conditions.
Same frozen gold reference for all comparable conditions.
Workflow configuration records applicable schemas, prompts, code, compute environment and stop criteria.
C0 records any tool or model assistance.
explicit_exclusion: The implemented but live-unrun bounded public-web company-research path is not a C0-C3 experimental condition. Its controls may support engineering claims only and cannot substitute for C0/C3 or live operational findings.
limitations: The exhibit is a conceptual, non-empirical author synthesis and does not report result values, sample sizes, thresholds, costs, time savings or participant outcomes.
The stated parity controls are protocol requirements; the exhibit does not prove that an unexecuted study achieved parity.
Implemented C1/C2 evidence is bounded to synthetic labelled D0 cases and cannot be generalised to real portfolio or practitioner performance.
C0 and human-result C3 execution remains protocol-only and currently NO-GO; null held outcomes are not replaced by synthetic measurements.
A C0 manual report is an evaluated output, not an independent gold reference.
The exhibit does not validate ethics/data authority, the gold-construction process, the frozen evaluation bundle or the live-unrun company-research path.
The complete plain-text companion provides reading-order access; no claim is made that the generated dissertation PDF is tagged.

validation.standalone_compile: Passed with Tectonic using the dissertation style through a temporary, non-retained book harness.
validation.scoped_tex_warnings: No overfull boxes, underfull boxes, LaTeX warnings or package warnings from the exhibit; the harness emitted only the existing inputenc-with-Unicode-engine package warning.
validation.layout: Visually inspected at 180 dpi: one dedicated A4 portrait table page, all seven columns readable, no clipping, no colour-dependent encoding, and the following section starts after the post-table clearpage.
validation.integration_boundary: The chapter was not edited. Full-dissertation placement must be rechecked after the approved Section 3.2 input is added.

outputs.role: One-page portrait LaTeX condition matrix with deterministic placement boundaries.
Complete plain-text alternative with expanded condition, parity, scoring and evidence-state boundaries.

self_hash_policy: The provenance file's own SHA-256 is reported externally because embedding it would create a self-referential hash.
